When `expand` is 1, it calls `glob(cfgfile, ...)` which populates `globbuf`. Then it iterates through `globbuf.gl_pathv[it]` and calls `read_config_expand(globbuf.gl_pathv[it], 0)`. Inside that recursive call, if the config file contains an `include` directive, it calls `read_config_expand(val, 1)` again, which calls `glob()` again.

The heap-use-after-free likely happens because `glob()` internally may free and reallocate memory, and the `globbuf.gl_pathv` pointers from the outer `glob()` call could become dangling if the inner `glob()` call reuses the same memory.
